capabilities: Insert barcodes into notes using code blocks
Select specific barcode types such as Code 128, EAN-13, UPC or Codabar
Customize barcode appearance with barcode-custom options
Auto-generate checksum digits for supported barcode types
disambiguation: It renders barcodes only, not QR codes; the README points readers to a separate plugin for QR codes.
extras: Docs note a limitation: barcodes are not refreshed after changing custom options. Manual installation folder is .obsidian/plugins/obsidian-barcode.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render barcodes inside notes.

relations.evidence: It uses the JsBarcode plugin to generate the barcode.

summary: Barcode renderer that generates customizable barcodes (Code 128, EAN, UPC, MSI, Codabar and more) in notes via code blocks.
